title: Sixteen Editions and One Lost Entry
subtitle: 语言与文化 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 语言与文化（历史社会与文化·语言与文化）
meta: 主题语境：语言与文化（历史社会与文化·语言与文化）　|　核心词汇：dictionary　|　正文 346 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 dictionary 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1945 the scholar ① compiled a dictionary that no press in the city would have printed, and he said the compiling was the whole of the work. The ② dictionary, meaning the word list and not the book, ran sixteen editions and stayed unchecked in the proof; a dictionary, he said, is the only thing in a study that is judged by how long it is left unbound.

Every ③ dictionary in that study had the same lost entry at the back of it, and the ④ dictionary at the end, meaning the one they kept for the dialect words and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever consulted twice. A dictionary, his assistant said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to compile; the scholar said the patience is the part that fills sixteen editions.

The bookseller meant the other thing entirely: she said ⑤ the dictionary was the whole of the shelf, meaning the book and not the word list. The ⑥ dictionary, meaning the book and not any of that, is the only thing on a shelf that everybody buys and nobody opens; dictionary, she said, is either something you compile or the only word that means both a word list and a book. She said the book is the part they remember.

By 1954 the ⑦ dictionary had become a line in a catalogue, and the catalogue had become an argument about the lost entry. The ⑧ dictionary of the whole thing, the scholar wrote in September, was one study and sixteen editions of compiling; dictionary, he said, is either the one at the end or the reason you learned to check. She said the checking was never mentioned.

The ⑨ dictionary I remember is the one at the end, which was bound in 1968 and is still described as the fullest in the city. A ⑩ dictionary, the assistant said in 1970, is the only thing that improves by being consulted; every dictionary, she said, is a book that has agreed to look like a word list. She said the book was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 词典；字典（指书房里编成的那一部）
B. n. 词典（指那份词表本身，与那本书相对）
C. 固定搭配：compile a dictionary 编纂一部词典
D. n. 词典（指留给方言词用的那一部）
E. n. 词典；字典（抽象总称，指一间书房的词典之学）
F. n. 词典（指书目上写到、被列名的那一部）
G. n. 词典（指书架上摆着的那本书）
H. n. 词典（抽象总称，指人人购买却无人翻阅的那本）

items.q: compiled a dictionary that no press in the city would have printed
The dictionary, meaning the word list and not the book
the dictionary was the whole of the shelf
the dictionary had become a line in a catalogue
The dictionary of the whole thing
A dictionary, the assistant said in 1970

answers.why: compile a dictionary 意为“编纂一部词典”，1945 年学者编纂了一部全城没有一家出版社肯印的词典。
dictionary 意为“词典”，指那份词表本身而不是那本书，它历经十六个版次而在校样上没有核对。
dictionary 意为“词典”，指那间书房里每一部词典，每一部后面都缺着同一个词条。
dictionary 意为“词典”，指留给方言词用的那一部，是唯一有人查阅过两次的。
dictionary 意为“词典”，指书架上摆着的那本书，书商说这本书就是那层架子的全部。
dictionary 意为“词典”，指人人购买却无人翻阅的那本而不是那份词表，是书架上人人都买、却无人翻开的东西。
dictionary 意为“词典”，指书目上写到、被列名的那一部，到 1954 年这部词典成了书目里的一行。
dictionary 意为“词典、字典”，学者九月写道，整件事的词典之学是一间书房和十六个版次的编纂。
dictionary 意为“词典”，我记得的是末尾那一部，1968 年装订成册，至今仍被说成全城最完备的。
dictionary 为抽象总称，助手 1970 年说，一部词典是唯一会因为被查阅而变得更好的东西。
